milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because killing a chicken drops raw chicken (item ID 'chicken') which ends up in the player's inventory. The player has a diamond sword for one-hit kills and 4 chickens are within 3-5 blocks of spawn. inventory_has is preferred over kill_entity or count_in_box_at_most because the task goal is obtaining the animal product.

Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_leaves with shears drops the block as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player has shears provided and the dark oak tree with persistent=true leaves is ~10 blocks from spawn with lower canopy at y+3 (reachable from ground). This directly confirms the mining action was successful.

Uses inventory_has because smelting raw chicken in the furnace produces cooked_chicken which the player must retrieve into their inventory. The furnace is at spawn-relative (~12, 0, ~7) near the dark oak tree. Player has coal for fuel and raw chicken from the hunt task. MCBench tracks furnace smelting under craft_item counters, but inventory_has is the most reliable check since the player must pick up the output.
